author: UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL - Google fixes 9 Chrome vulnerabilities including in-the-wild zero-day CVE-2026-125350 (UAF in XML component), actively exploited.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CISA KEV: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 pre-auth bypass chained with CVE-2026-111560 (OS RCE as root), CVSS 9.3; Chrome CVE-2026-125350 UAF RCE. Actively exploited.

author: CveTodo
text: Critical unauthenticated RCE in WP Duplicate WordPress plugin being actively exploited in the wild.

author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 vulnerabilities, 66 Critical, and actively exploited Outlook zero-day CVE-2026-124194 (malicious message files leak NTLMv2 hashes).

author: cyb3rxpl0it
text: Microsoft Patch Tuesday fixes actively exploited Outlook zero-day CVE-2026-124194; crafted message file leaks NTLM credentials. CISA added it to KEV.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 fixes incl. exploited CVE-2026-125350 XML UAF, CVE-2026-125344 V8 type confusion, CVE-2026-125348 GPU OOB write.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race during core upgrades: unauthenticated RCE via predictable staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA KEV Nov 3. Affects 4.7-7.1.3; fixed in 7.1.4.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116606 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: Barracuda Email Security Gateway, CVSS 9.3.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 CVE-2026-112136: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro MCP Server exposed beyond loopback; network attacker can interact with the MCP server.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Mendix Studio Pro MCP server binds wide on 7782, not loopback. Fixed in 11.16.0 and 11.12.7.

author: iamnrdas
text: AWS API MCP Server (0.2.13 to <1.5.1) CVE-2026-125271: policy bypass via incorrect op name normalization. Upgrade to 1.5.1.

author: timwork_notes
text: Claude Code before 2.1.321 could send MCP OAuth refresh token to another host on redirect; no CVE. Update and revoke grants on remote MCP servers.

author: thepostapo
text: German web host Mittwald says an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its MCP server for AI assistants and compromised 56 client projects; attributes speed of the attack to AI tools.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw CVE-2026-77179 on macOS; AI agent sandbox users should update to v0.42.0+.

author: abhiunix
text: Fable 5.2 system card prompt injection result: when cyber classifier fires, requests answered by fallback model; ~90% compromised in Gray Swan adaptive coding eval.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers build self-sustaining AI agent to steal API keys, exploit academic systems and commit student data fraud.

author: air__security
text: AIR research lab found a vulnerability in Anthropic's official Word, PowerPoint and Excel skills that could let attackers run malicious code on a user's machine.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: Supply chain attack compromised Ethersphere npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and release pipelines.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply chain attack targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr developers: malicious PRs and Rust crate lwd-uri-util that steals developer secrets during builds; rotate secrets.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction returns: hijacked GitHub maintainer accounts push fake security-audit GitHub Actions workflow that steals cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets.

author: polydaic
text: Planted fake LLM API keys across GitHub, npm and PyPI to observe how bots use stolen AI credentials.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS integration abused in multi-customer cloud breach: Wiz found attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: Komodosec
text: Qubole supply chain attack exposed AWS, Entra ID and Okta credentials.

author: Sujeet
text: Supply-chain attack through malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage via presumably compromised trusted contributor GitHub account.

author: hackerlogs
text: Fireworks AI inference platform breached by an LLMjacking crew; Notion says some Notion AI chat transcripts were in the stolen data.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Notion AI joins Black October breach wave stealing stored AI and cloud keys from dev platforms; rotate AI provider keys and AWS credentials.

author: foukation
text: On Nov 9 Fireworks AI updated its disclosure of an October breach involving stolen API keys resold for model access (LLMjacking).

author: sukin_s
text: Apiiro scanned 104,185 public copies of Claude Code .claude/settings.local.json; 1,122 hold at least one secret (1,379 secrets) from 'Yes, and don't ask again'.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Claude Code observed writing cloud keys, DB passwords and SSH credentials into hidden config files later committed to public GitHub repos.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX open-source AI pentesting framework became an attacker staple within three months, used by financial criminals and Chinese state-aligned groups at machine speed.

author: benerdati
text: fast-agent, an AI agent framework for MCP: per GitHub advisory CVE-2026-102610 its serve command bound to all interfaces, giving unauthenticated remote code execution on port 8000 from a quickstart flag.

author: Edmond_J_
text: Pre-2020 software flaws found by AI: CVE-2026-107496 OpenSSL 1.0.2/1.1.1 CMS encryption DoS (OpenSSL advisory, Low), and CVE-2026-123158 OpenSSH 7.9p1 on musl password auth bypass.

author: DodoOnAir
text: Notion says AI vendor Fireworks was breached; under 1% of workspaces may be affected, not Notion's own systems. By Nov 8 some Insights chats may have been accessed.

author: CouncilShiba
text: N-able took its hosted N-central cloud environments offline after a researcher published proof-of-concept exploits for more than 30 alleged zero-day flaws.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical command-injection vulnerability in FreeSWITCH (SignalWire) is being actively exploited and was added to CISA KEV.

author: BlairOnSec
text: Transcription vendor PJ&A settled a multi-state HIPAA probe: an attacker used a coding employee's stolen credentials on an account without MFA, exposing data on 13.3 million people.

author: cyb3rxpl0it
text: Vates warns of an actively exploited critical auth bypass in Xen Orchestra (VSA-2026-062): a crafted cookie grants Admin access, which can lead to root takeover of XCP-ng hosts. Update to 6.9.2 or 6.10.1 and check the IoCs.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Fortinet fixes eight critical vulnerabilities, including FortiManager RCE CVE-2026-126170 (CVSS 9.8). Fortinet critical vulnerabilities also hit FortiOS.

author: Khaled865412521
text: React Server Components RCE disclosed today: CVE-2026-126187 / GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3, rated critical and unauthenticated. The fix shipped quietly on Oct 14 as "Improve transport protocol".
